title: Contract precision multiplies verified scope
summary: Greater contract precision can increase the governable scope and the verified responsibility per usage without expanding product authority.
preconditions: A current contract, evidence boundary, owner and stop condition are explicit.
procedure: Separate deterministic evidence from authority decisions.
Measure the surface that is actually verified.
Keep external and human boundaries explicit.
Expand only the scope whose dependencies and rollback are governed.
decision_rules: Do not convert precision into permission.
Do not treat a larger documented scope as production readiness.
stop_conditions: Stop when the next step requires authority, external evidence, runtime, provider access or product semantics.
validation: Macro 03 phase graph, F-004 family record and B-7 closure matrix are internally consistent.
failure_modes: Equating more documentation with more operational capability.
Using a broad mission to bypass a named frontier.
recovery: Return to the last green station and narrow the next block to the first unresolved authority boundary.

evidence_refs.claim: The graph distinguishes governed documentary scope from unresolved authority.
B-7 can be ready for acceptance without claiming production readiness.

confidence.rationale: Development-origin observation from one Macro 03 graph and closure exercise; field confirmation is absent.
